name: NIAID defined term
abstract: A schema:DefinedTerm with the annotations the NIAID Data Discovery Portal adds to the terms it attaches to a dataset: whether a curator checked the term, the text it was matched from, who curated it, and a taxon's common name. The annotations occur only on DefinedTerms, so the block requires that type. Uses building blocks: bioschemasSample (bioschemasProperties).
